julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.title: Julier · Albula · Flüela Graubünden Triangle · part 1
julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.slogan: Chur fuel to Julierpass high road · one way

waypoints.name: Chur fuel gate
waypoints.advice: Chur is where the day begins. Next is Lenzerheide balcony road, climbing 882 m.

waypoints.name: Lenzerheide balcony road
waypoints.advice: Lenzerheide balcony road comes up 62 km in. The road climbs 882 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Julierpass high road, climbing 809 m.

waypoints.name: Julierpass high road
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 124 km. The road climbs 809 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher.

sections.advice: Chur fuel gate → Lenzerheide balcony road climbs about 882 m in 17 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Lenzerheide balcony road → Julierpass high road climbs about 809 m in 39 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 38 km. 882 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.story: A 124 km one-way ride from near Chur, about 2 h 21 of riding. The highest point is 2,284 m. Lenzerheide Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off.
